about: Capture-time provenance for docs/screens/*.png (#335). One row per shot, written by the session that took the pixels: sha256/canvas are properties of the bytes, origin/install/url/seed/level/layout/sampleRate/build are properties of the instrument and cannot be recovered from the PNG afterwards. `node tools/recap.js check` verifies each row against the file it addresses and against every other row of the same (seed, level, sampleRate); the vocabulary, the route verdicts and the audio-draw rule live in tools/recap.js, not here.

4abba57.note: The four blobs that draw a frame, sha256, read from the checkout that ran the capture. index.html plus the three js/ files that put a pixel on screen: js/10_assets.js makes the textures, js/20_level.js the lit materials, js/40_render.js is the rasterizer. `node tools/recap.js check` recomputes them from the tree it runs in and prints whether these frames still show what that tree ships (#536). The session that took these pixels proved this build off the wire, blob by blob, against the deployed page.

shots.note: RE-TAKEN from the DEPLOYED page for #797 at build 15e5d3f. The previous take bound 6434ac5; main has since merged 900b05f (#810), which moves js/40_render.js - one of the four blobs that draw a frame - so recap labelled those frames FRAME-STALE and the front page again described a picture that does not ship. This pass is the same eight poses re-run against the deploy, which serves main's bytes: index.html and all eleven js/ blobs served by that URL sha256-match this checkout, twelve for twelve, proved before the shutter. Route: tools/livecap.js devRoute - one page load and one boot per pose at ?dev=1&seed=60&boot=0, DEV.freeze(true), DEV.set("grain",0), DEV.clear() before the pose, shutter from the canvas after DEV.tick; window pinned (CAP_WIN=1440,906) so the canvas decodes 1440x763. Every seat, layout and luma below was read back out of the page that drew the frame, and every mean re-measured from these bytes with tools/recap.js's own decoder, not the capture harness's. Pose: the spawn seat, then DEV.clear() and DEV.spawn('grunt', 1, 6); the route's own seat search turned no bearing (offset 0 m) and left him at (11.10, 4.53), 6.00 m out, with 247 raster px of him painted. The route's DEV.clear() leaves the HUD reading 1 LEFT for this pose (1 enemy in the frame: the posed grunt). Layout signature 4083630493 for this sector under seed 60.
